title: Kofta
description: Kofta is a classic Arabic dish made from seasoned minced lamb or beef, shaped into skewers or logs and grilled or pan-seared until juicy and charred. It is typically served with bread, rice, sauces, and grilled vegetables for a complete meal.

ingredients.title: For the Kofta
items: 500g ground lamb (or lamb & beef mix, 70/30 ratio)
1 small onion, very finely grated (squeezed dry)
½ cup fresh parsley, finely chopped
¼ cup fresh coriander (cilantro), finely chopped

ingredients.title: For Serving
items: Warm Arabic bread or saffron rice
Tahini sauce or garlic yogurt sauce

instruction.title: Preparation Method
steps:
1. Prepare the Kofta Mixture:
• Combine ground meat, grated onion, garlic, parsley, coriander, and spices in a large bowl.
• Mix gently until evenly incorporated.
• Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or overnight.

2. Shape the Kofta:
• Wet hands with cold water or oil.
• Shape mixture into oval logs or form onto skewers.

3. Cook:
Grill Method:
• Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
• Grill koftas 3–4 minutes per side until charred and cooked through.

Pan Method:
• Heat olive oil in a skillet.
• Sear koftas on all sides for 8–10 minutes until fully cooked.

4. Serve:
• Arrange on platter with grilled vegetables and sauces.
• Serve with bread or rice.
• Garnish with parsley, sumac, or pomegranate seeds.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve with tahini or garlic yogurt sauce
Pair with saffron rice or warm flatbread
Garnish with sumac or fresh herbs

chefTips: Use a lamb-beef mix for best texture and flavor balance.
Always squeeze grated onion to avoid excess moisture.
Chill mixture before shaping to prevent breaking during cooking.
Charcoal grilling adds authentic smoky depth.
Do not overmix to keep kofta tender and juicy.
